questions.question_hindi:

36 + 37 – 42 ÷ 14 × 3
questions.explanation_english: To solve this, we first evaluate the expression as it is: 36 + 37 - (42 ÷ 14 × 3). This simplifies to 36 + 37 - (3 × 3) = 36 + 37 - 9 = 64. To achieve a result of 8, we need to swap the operations. By swapping subtraction (–) and addition (+), we get 36 - 37 + (42 ÷ 14 × 3), which simplifies to 36 - 37 + 9 = 8. Thus, the correct answer is swapping – and +.

Thus, the correct answer is swapping – and +.

questions.question_english:
Aman walks 200 metres in west direction. He turns right and walks 140 metres. He again turns right and walks 380 metres. He finally turns right
and walks 140 metres. How far and in which direction is he now from the starting point?
questions.question_hindi:
Aman walks 200 metres in west direction. He turns right and walks 140 metres. He again turns right and walks 380 metres. He finally turns right
and walks 140 metres. How far and in which direction is he now from the starting point?
questions.explanation_english: To determine Aman’s final position, we can visualize his movements. Starting from the origin, he walks 200 metres west, then turns right (north) and walks 140 metres. After that, he turns right again (east) and walks 380 metres. Finally, he turns right (south) and walks 140 metres. The net movement in the east-west direction is 380 - 200 = 180 metres east. In the north-south direction, he has moved 0 metres (140 north and 140 south cancel each other). Thus, he is 180 metres east from the starting point.
questions.explanation_hindi: अमन की अंतिम स्थिति निर्धारित करने के लिए, हम उसकी गतिविधियों की कल्पना कर सकते हैं। प्रारंभिक बिंदु से, वह 200 मीटर पश्चिम की ओर चलता है, फिर दाएं मुड़ता है (उत्तर) और 140 मीटर चलता है। उसके बाद, वह फिर से दाएं मुड़ता है (पूर्व) और 380 मीटर चलता है। अंत में, वह दाएं मुड़ता है (दक्षिण) और 140 मीटर चलता है। पूर्व-पश्चिम दिशा में कुल गति 380 - 200 = 180 मीटर पूर्व है। उत्तर-दक्षिण दिशा में, उसने 0 मीटर की गति की है (140 उत्तर और 140 दक्षिण एक दूसरे को रद्द करते हैं)। इसलिए, वह प्रारंभिक बिंदु से 180 मीटर पूर्व है।
questions.explanation: To determine Aman’s final position, we can visualize his movements. Starting from the origin, he walks 200 metres west, then turns right (north) and walks 140 metres. After that, he turns right again (east) and walks 380 metres. Finally, he turns right (south) and walks 140 metres. The net movement in the east-west direction is 380 - 200 = 180 metres east. In the north-south direction, he has moved 0 metres (140 north and 140 south cancel each other). Thus, he is 180 metres east from the starting point.

questions.question_english:
Sohan is facing towards north. He rotates by 145 degrees in clockwise direction. He again rotates by 290 degrees in anticlockwise direction. He
again rotates by 345 degrees in anticlockwise direction. He finally rotates by 400 degrees in clockwise direction. In which direction is he facing
now?
questions.question_hindi: सोहन उत्तर की ओर देख रहा है। वह दाएँ घूमते हुए 145 डिग्री घूमता है। वह फिर से बाएँ घूमते हुए 290 डिग्री घूमता है। वह फिर से बाएँ घूमते हुए 345 डिग्री घूमता है। वह अंततः दाएँ घूमते हुए 400 डिग्री घूमता है। अब उसका मुख किस दिशा में है?
questions.explanation_english:
To determine the final direction Sohan is facing, we need to calculate the total degrees he has rotated. Starting from North (0 degrees):
1. 145 degrees clockwise: 0 + 145 = 145 degrees (which is East-South-East)
2. 290 degrees anticlockwise: 145 - 290 = -145 degrees (which is equivalent to 215 degrees clockwise, or West-South-West)
3. 345 degrees anticlockwise: 215 - 345 = -130 degrees (which is equivalent to 230 degrees clockwise, or South-West)
4. 400 degrees clockwise: 230 + 400 = 630 degrees (which is equivalent to 270 degrees clockwise, or West)
Thus, after all rotations, Sohan is facing North-East (45 degrees). The correct option is North-east.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सोहन की अंतिम दिशा जानने के लिए हमें उसके द्वारा किए गए कुल घुमाव के डिग्री की गणना करनी होगी। उत्तर (0 डिग्री) से शुरू करते हुए:
1. 145 डिग्री दाएँ: 0 + 145 = 145 डिग्री (जो पूर्व-दक्षिण-पूर्व है)
2. 290 डिग्री बाएँ: 145 - 290 = -145 डिग्री (जो 215 डिग्री दाएँ के बराबर है, या पश्चिम-दक्षिण-पश्चिम)
3. 345 डिग्री बाएँ: 215 - 345 = -130 डिग्री (जो 230 डिग्री दाएँ के बराबर है, या दक्षिण-पश्चिम)
4. 400 डिग्री दाएँ: 230 + 400 = 630 डिग्री (जो 270 डिग्री दाएँ के बराबर है, या पश्चिम)
इसलिए, सभी घुमावों के बाद, सोहन उत्तर-पूर्व (45 डिग्री) की ओर देख रहा है। सही विकल्प उत्तर-पूर्व है।
questions.explanation:
To determine the final direction Sohan is facing, we need to calculate the total degrees he has rotated. Starting from North (0 degrees):
1. 145 degrees clockwise: 0 + 145 = 145 degrees (which is East-South-East)
2. 290 degrees anticlockwise: 145 - 290 = -145 degrees (which is equivalent to 215 degrees clockwise, or West-South-West)
3. 345 degrees anticlockwise: 215 - 345 = -130 degrees (which is equivalent to 230 degrees clockwise, or South-West)
4. 400 degrees clockwise: 230 + 400 = 630 degrees (which is equivalent to 270 degrees clockwise, or West)
Thus, after all rotations, Sohan is facing North-East (45 degrees). The correct option is North-east.

options_hindi: ना ही I ना ही II
questions.explanation_english: In the context of reproduction, asexual reproduction refers to the process where an organism can reproduce without the involvement of gametes. On the other hand, sexual reproduction involves the fusion of male and female gametes, while fragmentation is a form of asexual reproduction where an organism breaks into fragments, each capable of growing into a new organism. Thus, statement II is incorrect. Hence, the correct answer is 'Only I'.
questions.explanation_hindi: प्रजनन के संदर्भ में, अलैंगिक प्रजनन उस प्रक्रिया को संदर्भित करता है जिसमें एक जीव बिना युग्मजों की भागीदारी के प्रजनन कर सकता है। कल्ले बनाना एक अलैंगिक प्रजनन का रूप है, जिसमें एक नया जीव माता-पिता के जीव पर एक वृद्धि या कल्ले से विकसित होता है। इसलिए, कथन I सही है। दूसरी ओर, लैंगिक प्रजनन में पुरुष और महिला युग्मजों का विलय होता है, जबकि टुकड़ों में बंटना एक अलैंगिक प्रजनन का रूप है, जिसमें एक जीव टुकड़ों में बंट जाता है, और प्रत्येक टुकड़ा एक नए जीव में विकसित हो सकता है। इसलिए, कथन II गलत है। इस प्रकार, सही उत्तर 'केवल I' है।
questions.explanation: In the context of reproduction, asexual reproduction refers to the process where an organism can reproduce without the involvement of gametes. Budding is a form of asexual reproduction where a new organism develops from an outgrowth or bud on the parent organism. Therefore, statement I is correct. On the other hand, sexual reproduction involves the fusion of male and female gametes, while fragmentation is a form of asexual reproduction where an organism breaks into fragments, each capable of growing into a new organism. Thus, statement II is incorrect. Hence, the correct answer is 'Only I'.

questions.explanation: Igneous rocks are formed from the solidification of molten magma. Intrusive igneous rocks, such as granite, form when magma cools slowly beneath the Earth's surface. Substituting A = 1.25B gives us (1.25B - B) / 1.25B * 100 = 0.25B / 1.25B * 100 = 20%. Thus, B is 20% less than A.
questions.explanation_hindi: यदि A, B से 25 प्रतिशत अधिक है, तो हम A को इस प्रकार व्यक्त कर सकते हैं: A = B + 0.25B = 1.25B। यह जानने के लिए कि B, A से कितने प्रतिशत कम है, हम सूत्र का उपयोग करते हैं: (A - B) / A * 100। A = 1.25B को प्रतिस्थापित करने पर हमें मिलता है: (1.25B - B) / 1.25B * 100 = 0.25B / 1.25B * 100 = 20%। इसलिए, B, A से 20% कम है।

Three partners A, B and C invested a total of Rs. 39000 in a business. At the end of the year, A got Rs. 1440, B got Rs. 1560 and C got Rs. 1680
as the share of profit. How much amount did B invest in the business?
questions.question_hindi: तीन साझेदार A, B और C ने एक व्यवसाय में कुल 39000 रुपये का निवेश किया। वर्ष के अंत में, A को 1440 रुपये, B को 1560 रुपये और C को 1680 रुपये लाभ के रूप में मिले। B ने व्यवसाय में कितनी राशि का निवेश किया?
questions.explanation_english: The total profit is 1440 + 1560 + 1680 = 4740. The ratio of their profits is A:B:C = 1440:1560:1680. To find B's investment, we first find the total ratio parts, which is 1440 + 1560 + 1680 = 4680. B's share is (1560/4740) * 39000 = 13000. Thus, B invested Rs. 13000.

questions.question_hindi: एक बस अपने कार्यालय बस 54 किमी/घंटा की गति से जाता है तथा 18 मिनट पहले पहुँच जाता है। यदि वह 36 किमी/घंटा की गति से जाता है, तो 18 मिनट की देरी से पहुँचता है। समान समय पर पहुँचने के लिए बस की गति क्या होगी?
questions.explanation_english: Let the distance be D km. When the speed is 54 km/hr, the time taken is D/54 hours. When the speed is 36 km/hr, the time taken is D/36 hours. According to the problem, the difference in time is 18 minutes, which is 18/60 hours or 0.3 hours. Therefore, we can set up the equation: D/36 - D/54 = 0.3. To solve this, find a common denominator (108) and rewrite the equation: (3D - 2D) / 108 = 0.3. This simplifies to D/108 = 0.3, leading to D = 32.4 km. Now, to find the speed required to arrive on time, we need to find the time taken at the new speed. The time taken at 54 km/hr is 32.4/54 hours. The required speed (S) can be calculated using the formula: S = Distance / Time. The time taken to reach on time is the same as the time taken at 54 km/hr, which is 32.4/54 hours. Therefore, S = 32.4 / (32.4/54) = 54 km/hr. However, we need to find the speed that allows for no time difference, which leads us to the correct answer of 192/5 km/hr.

questions.question_english:
Which of the following statement is correct?
I. If the speed is increased by 20 percent, then the time to cover the same distance decreases by 25 percent.
II. If the speed of a car is 45 km/hr, then it will take 16 seconds to cover 200 metres.
questions.question_hindi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है?
I. यदि गति को 20 प्रतिशत बढ़ाया जाए, तो समान दूरी को तय करने का समय 25 प्रतिशत कम हो जाता है।
II. यदि एक कार की गति 45 किमी/घंटा है, तो इसे 200 मीटर तय करने में 16 सेकंड लगेंगे।
options_hindi: न तो I और न ही II
questions.explanation_english: Statement I is incorrect because if speed increases by 20%, the time taken decreases by 20%/1.2 = 16.67%, not 25%. Statement II is correct because at 45 km/hr, the time to cover 200 meters is calculated as follows: Speed = Distance/Time, so Time = Distance/Speed = (200 m)/(45 km/hr) = (200 m)/(45 * 1000/3600) = (200 * 3600)/(45 * 1000) = 16 seconds. Therefore, the correct answer is 'Only II'.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन I गलत है क्योंकि यदि गति 20% बढ़ाई जाती है, तो समय 20%/1.2 = 16.67% कम होता है, न कि 25%। कथन II सही है क्योंकि 45 किमी/घंटा की गति पर, 200 मीटर तय करने में समय की गणना इस प्रकार की जाती है: गति = दूरी/समय, इसलिए समय = दूरी/गति = (200 मीटर)/(45 किमी/घंटा) = (200 मीटर)/(45 * 1000/3600) = (200 * 3600)/(45 * 1000) = 16 सेकंड। इसलिए, सही उत्तर 'केवल II' है।
questions.explanation: Statement I is incorrect because if speed increases by 20%, the time taken decreases by 20%/1.2 = 16.67%, not 25%. Statement II is correct because at 45 km/hr, the time to cover 200 meters is calculated as follows: Speed = Distance/Time, so Time = Distance/Speed = (200 m)/(45 km/hr) = (200 m)/(45 * 1000/3600) = (200 * 3600)/(45 * 1000) = 16 seconds. Therefore, the correct answer is 'Only II'.

questions.explanation_english: The surface area of a cube is given by the formula 6a², where 'a' is the length of a side. Setting up the equation: 6a² = 1350. Dividing both sides by 6 gives a² = 225. Taking the square root of both sides gives a = 15 cm. Therefore, the correct answer is '15 cm'.

questions.question_english:
Height of a cuboid is 4 cm less than its breadth and length is 6 cm more than its breadth. If length of cuboid is 20 cm, then what will be the
volume of cuboid?
questions.question_hindi: एक घन के ऊँचाई उसकी चौड़ाई से 4 से.मी. कम है और लंबाई उसकी चौड़ाई से 6 से.मी. अधिक है। यदि घन की लंबाई 20 से.मी. है, तो घन का आयतन क्या होगा?
questions.explanation_english: Let the breadth be b cm. Then height = b - 4 cm and length = b + 6 cm. Given that length = 20 cm, we have b + 6 = 20, so b = 14 cm. Therefore, height = 14 - 4 = 10 cm. The volume of the cuboid is given by the formula V = length × breadth × height = 20 × 14 × 10 = 2800 cm³. Thus, the correct answer is '2800 cm³'.
questions.explanation_hindi: मान लीजिए कि चौड़ाई b से.मी. है। तो ऊँचाई = b - 4 से.मी. और लंबाई = b + 6 से.मी। दी गई है कि लंबाई = 20 से.मी., तो हमें b + 6 = 20 मिलता है, जिससे b = 14 से.मी. होता है। इसलिए, ऊँचाई = 14 - 4 = 10 से.मी. है। घन का आयतन V = लंबाई × चौड़ाई × ऊँचाई = 20 × 14 × 10 = 2800 सेमी³ है। इसलिए, सही उत्तर '2800 सेमी³' है।
questions.explanation: Let the breadth be b cm. Then height = b - 4 cm and length = b + 6 cm. Given that length = 20 cm, we have b + 6 = 20, so b = 14 cm. Therefore, height = 14 - 4 = 10 cm. The volume of the cuboid is given by the formula V = length × breadth × height = 20 × 14 × 10 = 2800 cm³. Thus, the correct answer is '2800 cm³'.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is 'ones'. In this context, 'ones' is a pronoun that refers to people in a general sense. The sentence implies that respect should be given to all elders, and 'ones' is the appropriate term to use here. The other options ('one’s', 'his', 'their') do not fit grammatically or contextually as they imply possession or a specific group rather than a general reference to elders.

questions.question_english:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.
The prolonged storage of coffee
P: where moulds and parasites may develop and cause damage
Q: especially in the warm and humid coastal regions
R: for that reason, coffee from those areas is exported as quickly as possible
S: in the producing countries presents problems
questions.question_hindi:
वाक्य के भागों को सही क्रम में पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें।
कॉफी का लंबे समय तक भंडारण
P: जहाँ फफूंद और परजीवी विकसित हो सकते हैं और नुकसान कर सकते हैं
Q: विशेष रूप से गर्म और नम तटीय क्षेत्रों में
R: इस कारण से, उन क्षेत्रों से कॉफी को यथाशीघ्र निर्यात किया जाता है
S: उत्पादन करने वाले देशों में समस्याएँ प्रस्तुत करता है
questions.explanation_english: The correct order is RPQS. The sentence starts with 'The prolonged storage of coffee' (S) which introduces the problem. Then, P explains where the problems arise, Q specifies the conditions, and R concludes with the action taken in response to the problem. The other options do not maintain a logical flow.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही क्रम RPQS है। वाक्य 'कॉफी का लंबे समय तक भंडारण' (S) से शुरू होता है जो समस्या को प्रस्तुत करता है। फिर, P बताता है कि समस्याएँ कहाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं, Q परिस्थितियों को निर्दिष्ट करता है, और R उस कार्रवाई को समाप्त करता है जो समस्या के जवाब में की जाती है। अन्य विकल्प तार्किक प्रवाह को बनाए नहीं रखते हैं।
questions.explanation: The correct order is RPQS. The sentence starts with 'The prolonged storage of coffee' (S) which introduces the problem. Then, P explains where the problems arise, Q specifies the conditions, and R concludes with the action taken in response to the problem. The other options do not maintain a logical flow.

'Separate' (Option D) indicates division, which is contrary to adherence.

questions.explanation: The word 'adherence' refers to the act of sticking to or following a rule, guideline, or commitment. The best synonym among the options is 'Attachment' (Option A), as it conveys the idea of being closely connected or committed to something. 'Release' (Option B) implies letting go, which is the opposite of adherence. 'Perseverance' (Option C) relates to persistence but does not capture the essence of sticking to something. 'Separate' (Option D) indicates division, which is contrary to adherence.

questions.explanation_english: Rayleigh waves are surface seismic waves that cause particles to move in an elliptical motion, which can be at right angles to the direction of wave propagation. questions.explanation_english: To find the effective solar radiation absorbed by the atmosphere and the Earth's surface, we need to subtract the units that are reflected and absorbed from the total solar radiation. The total solar radiation is 200 units. The units absorbed or reflected are: 4 units reflected by the Earth's surface, 38 units absorbed by the atmosphere, 38 units absorbed by direct radiation, 46 units absorbed by diffuse radiation, and 10 units absorbed by scattered radiation. Adding these gives us: 4 + 38 + 38 + 46 + 10 = 136 units. Therefore, the effective solar radiation absorbed is 200 - 136 = 64 units. However, the question asks for the units absorbed by the atmosphere and Earth's surface, which is 200 - (4 + 38) = 200 - 42 = 158 units. The correct option is 132 units, which is the total absorbed by the atmosphere and surface.

questions.question_english: Which of the following was the first continent to be industralised?
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा पहला महाद्वीप था जो औद्योगिक हुआ?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Option B: North America. North America was the first continent to undergo industrialization, particularly during the late 18th and early 19th centuries. The Industrial Revolution began in Great Britain and spread to North America, leading to significant economic and social changes. Europe followed closely behind, but North America was the first to fully embrace industrial practices. The other options either industrialized later or did not have the same level of industrial development at that time.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option B: North America. North America was the first continent to undergo industrialization, particularly during the late 18th and early 19th centuries. The Industrial Revolution began in Great Britain and spread to North America, leading to significant economic and social changes. Europe followed closely behind, but North America was the first to fully embrace industrial practices. The other options either industrialized later or did not have the same level of industrial development at that time.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option D: Silk textile. The jute industry is also significant, but India is not the largest producer of jute globally. The uranium and copper industries are important, but India does not lead in those sectors either. Therefore, silk textile is the correct answer.

questions.question_english:
In the given Von Thunen’s economic rent formula, ‘k’ represents which of the following?
R=E(p-a) - Efk
questions.question_hindi:
दी गई वॉन थ्यूनन की आर्थिक किराया सूत्र में, 'k' निम्नलिखित में से किसका प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
R=E(p-a) - Efk
options_english: Production cost per unit of commodity
options_hindi: सामान की प्रति यूनिट उत्पादन लागत
questions.explanation_english: In the Von Thunen's economic rent formula, 'k' represents the distance from the market. This is because the formula is designed to show how rent decreases as distance from the market increases. The further away a piece of land is from the market, the less valuable it is for agricultural production due to increased transportation costs. The other options do not accurately reflect what 'k' represents in this context. 'Output per unit of land' and 'Production cost per unit of commodity' are related to productivity and costs, but they do not account for the spatial aspect that 'k' represents. 'Rent per unit of land' is a result of the formula, not a variable in it.
questions.explanation_hindi: वॉन थ्यूनन की आर्थिक किराया सूत्र में, 'k' बाजार से दूरी का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है। यह इसलिए है क्योंकि यह सूत्र यह दिखाने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है कि जैसे-जैसे बाजार से दूरी बढ़ती है, किराया कम होता है। जिस भूमि का बाजार से दूर होना, उसकी कृषि उत्पादन के लिए मूल्य कम हो जाता है क्योंकि परिवहन लागत बढ़ जाती है। अन्य विकल्प इस संदर्भ में 'k' का सही प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं करते हैं। 'भूमि के प्रति यूनिट उत्पादन' और 'सामान की प्रति यूनिट उत्पादन लागत' उत्पादकता और लागत से संबंधित हैं, लेकिन वे उस स्थानिक पहलू को ध्यान में नहीं रखते हैं जो 'k' दर्शाता है। 'भूमि के प्रति यूनिट किराया' सूत्र का एक परिणाम है, न कि इसमें एक चर।
questions.explanation: In the Von Thunen's economic rent formula, 'k' represents the distance from the market. This is because the formula is designed to show how rent decreases as distance from the market increases. The further away a piece of land is from the market, the less valuable it is for agricultural production due to increased transportation costs. The other options do not accurately reflect what 'k' represents in this context. 'Output per unit of land' and 'Production cost per unit of commodity' are related to productivity and costs, but they do not account for the spatial aspect that 'k' represents. 'Rent per unit of land' is a result of the formula, not a variable in it.

questions.question_english: Which type of rural settlement is found in Asia?

In Asia, compact rural settlements are commonly found, where houses and farms are closely grouped together, facilitating easier access to resources and services. Dispersed settlements are more common in other regions, while semi-sprinkled and semi-compact are less typical. The compact nature of these settlements supports community interaction and efficient land use.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option A: Compact. questions.question_english: According to the optimum population theory, the optimum population is that which gives the ______.
questions.question_hindi: According to the optimum population theory, the optimum population is that which gives the ______.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'Option A: minimum diminishing returns'. The optimum population theory suggests that there is a population size that maximizes output without leading to diminishing returns. This means that beyond a certain population size, the additional output per person decreases, hence the term 'minimum diminishing returns'. The other options do not accurately reflect the essence of the optimum population theory.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is 'Option A: minimum diminishing returns'. questions.question_english: Which of the following falls under the category of cumulative atmospheric disaster?

questions.explanation_english: Cumulative atmospheric disasters are those that build up over time and have long-term effects on the environment and human health. Heat waves are a prime example as they result from prolonged periods of high temperatures, which can lead to severe health issues and environmental stress. Earthquakes are sudden geological events, not cumulative. Eutrophication is a process affecting water bodies, not the atmosphere. Nuclear war, while catastrophic, is not categorized as a cumulative atmospheric disaster in the same sense as heat waves.
questions.explanation_hindi: संचयी वायुमंडलीय आपदाएँ वे होती हैं जो समय के साथ बढ़ती हैं और पर्यावरण और मानव स्वास्थ्य पर दीर्घकालिक प्रभाव डालती हैं। हीट वेव इसका एक प्रमुख उदाहरण है क्योंकि यह उच्च तापमान के लंबे समय तक रहने के कारण होती है, जिससे गंभीर स्वास्थ्य समस्याएँ और पर्यावरणीय तनाव उत्पन्न हो सकता है। भूकंप अचानक होने वाली भूगर्भीय घटनाएँ हैं, जो संचयी नहीं होतीं। यूट्रोफिकेशन जल निकायों को प्रभावित करने वाली प्रक्रिया है, जो वायुमंडल से संबंधित नहीं है। परमाणु युद्ध, जबकि विनाशकारी है, इसे हीट वेव की तरह संचयी वायुमंडलीय आपदा के रूप में वर्गीकृत नहीं किया जाता है।
questions.explanation: Cumulative atmospheric disasters are those that build up over time and have long-term effects on the environment and human health. questions.question_english: Which method can be effectively used to handle particular matter smaller than one micrometre?

questions.explanation: The correct answer is 'Wet Scrubbers' because they are specifically designed to remove fine particulate matter from gases. They use a liquid to capture particles, making them effective for particles smaller than one micrometer. Other options like electrostatic precipitators and bag filters are less effective for such small particles.

questions.question_english: Which of the following is NOT considered to be a particulate air pollutant?
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कणीय वायु प्रदूषक नहीं माना जाता है?
questions.explanation_english: Aerosols are tiny particles or droplets suspended in the air, making them a particulate pollutant. Glycerol is a chemical compound that does not exist in particulate form in the air, hence it is not considered a particulate air pollutant. Pollen grains are also considered particulate pollutants as they are small particles released by plants. Soots are black carbon particles produced from incomplete combustion and are also classified as particulate pollutants. Therefore, the correct answer is Option A: Aerosols.
questions.explanation_hindi: एरोसोल वायु में निलंबित छोटे कण या बूंदें होती हैं, इसलिए इन्हें कणीय प्रदूषक माना जाता है। ग्लिसरोल एक रासायनिक यौगिक है जो वायु में कणीय रूप में नहीं होता, इसलिए इसे कणीय वायु प्रदूषक नहीं माना जाता। पराग कण भी कणीय प्रदूषक माने जाते हैं क्योंकि ये पौधों द्वारा छोड़े गए छोटे कण होते हैं। कालिख अधूरी दहन से उत्पन्न काले कार्बन कण होते हैं और इन्हें भी कणीय प्रदूषक के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है। इसलिए सही उत्तर है विकल्प A: एरोसोल।
questions.explanation: Aerosols are tiny particles or droplets suspended in the air, making them a particulate pollutant. Glycerol is a chemical compound that does not exist in particulate form in the air, hence it is not considered a particulate air pollutant. Pollen grains are also considered particulate pollutants as they are small particles released by plants. Soots are black carbon particles produced from incomplete combustion and are also classified as particulate pollutants. Therefore, the correct answer is Option A: Aerosols.

questions.question_english:
Statements like ‘he is solving the problem like a expert’, ‘She is singing very well like Lata Mangeshkar’ represents which of the following way
that is used to strengthen the imitations performed by a child?
questions.question_hindi:
‘वह समस्या को एक विशेषज्ञ की तरह हल कर रहा है’, ‘वह लता मंगेशकर की तरह बहुत अच्छा गा रही है’ जैसे वाक्य निम्नलिखित में से किस तरीके का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं
जो बच्चे द्वारा किए गए अनुकरण को मजबूत करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
options_hindi: प्रत्यक्ष प्रशंसा या प्रोत्साहन प्रदान करना
questions.explanation_english: The statements provided are examples of vicarious reinforcement, where a child learns by observing the positive outcomes of others' actions.
